summary: Master telecom churn reduction with practical segmentation, pricing, and retention tools. Build scorecards, plans, and KPIs in 5 days.
lede: Telecom churn reduction uses subscriber analysis and commercial decisions to address preventable losses while protecting revenue quality. The course is for telecom professionals working with commercial, CRM, pricing or retention data who need to make better save decisions. Participants learn to segment subscribers with RFM and cohort analysis, design retention offers with margin controls, and build scorecards and action plans to track results.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for telecom professionals who already work with commercial, CRM, pricing, or customer-retention data and need to improve retention decisions.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, a spreadsheet tool such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, and familiarity with telecom commercial reports, CRM extracts, or churn summaries. The course works best when you can apply examples from your own commercial or retention context, although sample datasets and templates can be used if internal data is unavailable.
